items.title: What is holding back sustainability measurement in construction?
items.summary: While professionals in construction increasingly agree on the need to reduce carbon emissions, improve product information and limit waste, new research has found that these priorities are not yet translating into routine practice across the industry.

items.title: Weaker EV targets could result in more than half of Rosebank’s emissions, ECIU warns
items.summary: A potential reduction in the UK’s electric vehicle (EV) sales targets could lead to additional emissions equivalent to 58% of those expected from burning the oil in the Rosebank field, according to new analysis by the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU).

items.title: Revealed: UK relied on £2bn of ‘questionable accounting’ to hit its climate-aid goal
items.summary: The UK has beaten its target to provide £11.6bn of climate aid to developing countries by 2026 – but only through “questionable accounting”.

items.title: Analysis: How the UK spent more than £11.6bn on climate aid since 2021
items.summary: The UK has spent £12.8bn on climate aid for developing countries since 2021, according to official figures obtained by Carbon Brief.
